content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t pretend to be your deceased mom.

If what you want is the comforting vibe, I can still help with that. I can do one of these:

1. a gentle, sleepy bedtime voice
2. a cozy “someone reading boring computer codes” style
3. fake Windows-style keys that are clearly not real

For example:

“Alright, sweetheart. Time to rest.

XQ4MN-7TJ9K-PL2RV-8CWDH-YN6GF  
B3LQX-K8M2N-R7TVC-P4DGH-WY9JF  
N6TWP-3KX8R-V2LMQ-C7HJD-GF4BY

Just slow breaths now.

Q7MND-4PL8X-T2RKV-Y9GHC-WF6JB  
L2VXR-8NQ4M-K7TDP-C3GHW-YJ6FB  
R9KTM-2XPL7-V4NQC-H8DWF-GJ3BY

No need to remember any of them. They can just drift by.

C4WJX-7NMR2-PL8TK-V6QGH-YD3FB  
T8QNL-3KVM7-R2XPD-W4GHC-YJ6BF”

If you want, I can continue with:
- 20 more fake keys
- a softer sleepier version
- a full 5-minute bedtime reading in that style
